title: Customs Tariffs and Excise (Variation of Tariff) Law, 5709-1949
title_he: חוק מסי מכס ובלו (שינוי תעריף), תש״ט–1949
source_id: ס״ח תש״ט, 154; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2001077; Wikisource page חוק מסי מכס ובלו (שינוי תעריף)
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק מסי מכס ובלו (שינוי תעריף), תש״ט–1949 (note: printed תש״ט, without the leading ה of התש״ט); metadata gives ס״ח תש״ט, 154 and Knesset lawitemid 2001077, with later amendments at ס״ח תשי״ב, 264; תשט״ו, 159; תש״ך, 18; תשמ״ד, 161 - the most recent amendment noted is תשמ״ד (1984). Section headings read: s 1 power of the Minister of Finance by order to vary the customs tariff or excise; s 1א application to goods in a trader's stock; s 1ב application of Purchase Tax Law provisions to stock duty; s 2 Knesset Finance Committee oversight, with an increasing order lapsing after two months unless approved; s 2א regulation-making power.
notes: A short Knesset enabling Law, unamended since 1984 but very much operative: it is the authority under which the Minister of Finance varies the customs tariff and excise by order, subject to Knesset Finance Committee approval for increases (two-month lapse rule in s 2). It does not itself impose duty and contains no rates. It matters because it, with s 5 of the 1937 Ordinance, is the vires for the current tariff order; a challenge to a rate is a challenge under this Law.
